items.requirement: Pages and modules are files in the Theorem vault through the SDK Files API (theorem-files/1): Pages/<name>.page.json and Modules/<name>/module.json; saves are revision-checked
evidence: src/lib/modules/store.ts (usePages, usePage, useSavePage with expectedHash, useInstalledModules, useCreateModule)
src/lib/modules/contract.ts (theorem.page/1, theorem.module/1)

items.requirement: A module definition carries id, version, entry, settings, inputs, outputs, events, actions, requested capabilities and migrations
evidence: src/lib/modules/contract.ts moduleManifest
src/lib/modules/registry.ts ModuleDefinition, builtin, fromManifest
bun test src/lib/modules/modules.test.ts: 'module files'

items.requirement: An instance is one placement with its own id, title, settings version, settings and wiring; host-owned props are reserved
evidence: contract.ts InstanceProps and RESERVED_PROPS
bun test: 'a vault module may not take a theorem id or a host prop name'

items.requirement: A page is a durable object with its own navigation entry, not a route or ShellMode branch per page
evidence: One route, src/routes/_chat/pages.$pageId.tsx, keyed by vault entry id
One 'pages' ShellMode (src/components/shell/modes.tsx); the Pages panel lists every page, pinned first (src/components/pages/pages-panel.tsx)

items.requirement: Pages are built with Puck; the chat dock and the Vault stay on Dockview
evidence: @puckeditor/core 0.24.0; src/components/pages/puck-config.tsx and page-view.tsx (Render in use, Puck with Components, Outline, Preview and Fields while arranging)
src/components/shell/dock.tsx unchanged apart from the panel title in Pages mode

items.requirement: A setting can bind an instance to a resource: Index view, object type, vault file, conversation, App
evidence: src/components/pages/resource-field.tsx
contract.ts RESOURCE_KINDS

items.requirement: Value bindings: one instance's output drives another's input (selection drives an inspector)
evidence: src/components/pages/page-runtime.tsx useInputs, PageScopeProvider
bun test src/components/pages/page.test.tsx: a bound value shows another instance's output, inside a split too
That test found that no page-level scope was provided, so top-level bindings did not deliver; fixed with PageScopeProvider

Browser, 2026-11-06, Playwright against the dev server and a stub Theorem (not live Home, not theorem.rs): a Value bound to a Text showed it and followed edits while arranging, in use and after reopening

The browser check found bindings made during a session never delivered: React's effect replay disposed the page runtime while it stayed in use. Fixed with runtime.resume in a layout effect (page-runtime.tsx); bun test page.test.tsx 'a value published after the page is hidden and shown still arrives' and modules.test.ts 'a resumed runtime takes calls again; its instances wire afresh' fail without it

items.requirement: Events route to actions and to host actions (attach to the composer, ask in the composer), declared per composition, never a global bus
evidence: src/lib/modules/runtime.ts (one runtime per page view)
src/components/pages/connection-fields.tsx RoutesField
bun test: 'an event reaches the actions and host routes it is wired to'

items.requirement: Explicit transforms where types differ; nothing is converted silently
evidence: src/lib/modules/values.ts compatibility, convert, pick
bun test: 'conversions are explicit and checked', 'a route that does not say to convert delivers nothing', 'a binding across types must ask to convert'

items.requirement: Loop and stale-effect guards
evidence: Cycles refused and reported: bun test 'cycles are refused before they are made, and found when present'
Depth limit 8 and 30 events/s: bun test 'events handed round in a loop stop at the depth limit', 'an instance flooding events is stopped'
Equal outputs change nothing: bun test 'an equal output changes nothing'
Action handlers are the latest render's (useEffectEvent in useModuleAction): source only

items.requirement: No model call per click
evidence: Source: the runtime's only host effects are composer.attach (adds a reference) and composer.ask (adds it and focuses the composer); neither sends

items.requirement: Get a module by configuring an existing one
evidence: puck-config.tsx moduleComponent: settings, inputs and routes as Puck fields

items.requirement: Get a module by combining existing ones, and reuse the combination as a module with named inputs
evidence: Split and Tabs layout components (puck-config.tsx)
Save as module: src/components/pages/save-as-module.tsx over layout.ts extractComposite

bun test: 'extracting a composite exposes what crossed its edge', 'an outside route into the composite is cut; its other routes stay', 'a composite forwards its inner event; disposal stops everything'

Browser, 2026-11-06, Playwright against the dev server and a stub Theorem (not live Home, not theorem.rs): Save as module on a Split holding a Value bound to an outside Text gave the composite the input 'value'; one instance replaced the Split and the value arrived while arranging, in use and after a reload

The browser check found Save as module lost the unsaved arrangement: the new manifest made the catalog pending and the page fell back to its loading state. Fixed in store.ts useInstalledModules (pending only until the first read); bun test store.test.tsx fails without it

items.requirement: Create or install a new implementation without compiling it into the host catalog, in the first release
evidence: New module writes Modules/<name>/module.json and index.html (store.ts newModuleFiles, pages-panel.tsx NewModuleDialog)
Vault manifests join the catalog when the vault reports them (store.ts useInstalledModules)
Browser, 2026-11-06, Playwright against the dev server and a stub Theorem (not live Home, not theorem.rs): New module wrote Modules/<slug>/module.json and index.html and listed it as Sandboxed
It now opens index.html in the code editor (handler 'code'); the browser check found the HTML viewer it opened before is blank outside the desktop app

items.requirement: Untrusted modules run in an isolated sandbox with a scoped bridge; requested permissions are not grants; the person can stop or revoke
evidence: src/components/pages/sandboxed-module.tsx (grant gate, Stop, Run, Revoke), src/lib/modules/sandbox.ts, src/lib/modules/grants.ts

bun test src/lib/modules/sandbox.test.ts: undeclared or mistyped outputs and events refused; capabilities are the grant plus the module's own folder, never run; a grant holds only for the digest it was given for
bun test src/lib/blocks/hosted-app.test.ts: 'a page module reaches only the hosts it was allowed, whatever its page declares'

Browser, 2026-11-06, Playwright against the dev server and a stub Theorem (not live Home, not theorem.rs): while arranging only its summary (takes, gives, sends) shows; the gate offers Run it; the frame has sandbox="allow-scripts", a blob: src and origin null; its output reached a bound Value; Stop removed the frame, Run restored it, Revoke showed the gate again; an outside edit of index.html made it ask again

items.requirement: An unavailable module becomes a placeholder that keeps its state
evidence: bun test: 'a missing module becomes a placeholder and comes back unchanged', 'a placeholder resumes once its module arrives'
bun test page.test.tsx: 'a module this app does not have is held in place and comes back unchanged' (rendered)

items.requirement: Pages hold their displayed revision
evidence: page-view.tsx: the held revision, Show it for a newer one, Keep mine or Use the vault's on a save conflict

Browser, 2026-11-06, Playwright against the dev server and a stub Theorem (not live Home, not theorem.rs): an outside write was offered ('A newer version…') and replaced the page only on Show it; a conflicting save said 'This page changed in the vault since you opened it.'; Keep mine wrote the page's version; Use the vault's showed the other and left nothing unsaved
No automated test drives a conflicting save

items.requirement: Chat is modular without a second agent: the conversation binding picks which conversation, moving the composer keeps its draft, selection never auto-attaches
evidence: builtins.tsx theorem.conversation on the one runtime; one owner per page; keep or follow the open conversation
Selection reaches the composer only through a route to composer.attach or composer.ask

Browser, 2026-11-06, Playwright against the dev server and a stub Theorem (not live Home, not theorem.rs): a second conversation instance said 'The conversation shows in another place on this page.'; a typed draft survived switching to Chat mode and back, arranging and Done; a full reload clears it (the draft is per session)
Not observed: sending (the stub answers 501), or a selection reaching the composer in a browser; the no-auto-attach rule rests on source and unit tests

items.requirement: The Pages mode opens, a page can be created, arranged, saved and reopened in a browser
evidence: Browser, 2026-11-06, Playwright against the dev server and a stub Theorem (not live Home, not theorem.rs). Scripts drove: create a page, Arrange, drag Text and Value, bind, Save, Done, reopen from the Pages list; held revisions; a sandboxed module; Save as module; the conversation module; templates and modes as pages

Found and fixed: bindings not delivering after React's effect replay; Save as module losing the arrangement; New module opening in the running viewer; empty component groups shown; the first save of a mode's page ending Arrange (the mode went back to loading while it read the new file); a mode's file removed and written again showing what was read of the old one
Not exercised: Index view, Index inspector and Records table against real data

items.requirement: Shipped Index and coding layouts become templates; Index and IDE modes render from their page (owner: 'Start the template', 'Modes become pages too')
evidence: src/lib/modules/templates.ts: INDEX_TEMPLATE and CODING_TEMPLATE, rebuilt from modules; vault templates are Templates/<name>.page.json; MODE_PAGES maps index and ide to Modes/<mode>.page.json

builtins.tsx: Index view as the whole Index column ('Moves with' its own place or the Index panel), Index inspector events, IDE (Theia, Add to chat as the 'added' event), Agent terminal ('attach'); Theia and the conversation show in one place
layout-parts.tsx: page root fills the window with flush modules; Split with a fixed side and fold-when-empty

store.ts: useVaultTemplates, useCreatePage from a template, useSaveTemplate (a free name, expectedHash null), useModePage, useResetModePage; pages-panel.tsx Modes list and New page 'Start from'; save-as-template.tsx
mode-page.tsx: Index mode (desktop) and IDE mode render the mode's page with a held arrangement; the template while the vault is not open or the file does not parse, saying why

Tests: templates.test.ts; page.test.tsx (templates' connections valid, Split folds while only an empty inspector is in it); store.test.tsx (template then file then problem, create-only save, vault templates, a mode's page through its first save and a file coming and going); navigation.test.tsx

Browser, 2026-11-06, Playwright against the dev server and a stub Theorem (not live Home, not theorem.rs): Modes list, arrange and save Index mode, /index rendering the saved page with the inspector folded, Reset to the default, /ide rendering the Coding page, New page from Index and from Coding, Save as template offered by New page
Not exercised: Index modules against real data (the stub's Index has no items); Theia and the terminal (absent from the stub), so Add to chat reaching the terminal rests on source only
Limits: IDE mode's terminal width is the Split's saved size, not the right drawer's; Reset removes the file without a revision check
